rate_path.rationale: The minutes state the Committee held the federal funds rate target range at 0 to 1/4 percent and emphasized maintaining this rate for a considerable time due to persistent inflation below 2 percent and elevated unemployment. Forward guidance shows a clear bias toward holding rates low, with no indication of tightening or easing.
